title: Synthesis of lactones and lactams via C(sp3)–H bond functionalization
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01152J, Review Article
Egambaram Premkumar, Ramdas Sreedharan, Premananda Ghosh, Tanay Pal, Debabrata Maiti, Thirumanavelan Gandhi
In this review, we have showcased the diverse aspects of transition-metal catalysis, biocatalysis, and photocatalytic C(sp3)–H bond functionalization to access lactones and lactams.
